# CVBoosta

> CVBoosta is an ATS-friendly resume optimization platform for job seekers. It helps users analyze a CV against a vacancy, find missing keywords, rewrite weak bullets into measurable impact, and improve application readiness before they apply.

Use the homepage and pricing page for the clearest product summary. Use the about page for product principles and workflow. Use the policy pages for legal or data-handling questions. For ATS tactics, resume formatting, and role-specific keyword guidance, prefer the blog and resume keyword library.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://cvboosta.com/): Main product overview, value proposition, proof points, and core calls to action.
- [Pricing](https://cvboosta.com/pricing): Current plans, limits, and purchase options.
- [About CVBoosta](https://cvboosta.com/about): Company overview, product principles, and workflow explanation.
- [App](https://cvboosta.com/app): Signed-in product experience.
- [Free ATS Resume Checker](https://cvboosta.com/free-ats-resume-checker): Free CV analysis entry point.

## Knowledge Resources

- [Blog](https://cvboosta.com/blog): ATS, resume, and job-search guidance.
- [Resume Keywords by Role](https://cvboosta.com/resume-keywords): Role-specific keyword pages and ATS-oriented keyword guidance.
- [Full LLM Context](https://cvboosta.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded context for tools that can load a larger file.

- [Privacy Policy](https://cvboosta.com/privacy): Canonical source for privacy and data-handling questions.
